WITH recent_prices AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(high) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_high FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'),
vcp_candidates AS (SELECT symbol, company_name, enhanced_fund_score, vcp_score FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE vcp_breakout_pct > 0 AND snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'),
fundamental_candidates AS (SELECT symbol, enhanced_fund_score FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE enhanced_fund_score > 70 AND price_date = CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT r.symbol, r.recent_high, v.enhanced_fund_score, v.vcp_score
FROM recent_prices r
JOIN vcp_candidates v ON r.symbol = v.symbol
JOIN fundamental_candidates f ON r.symbol = f.symbol;

sql_templates.description: Calculate index returns over the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template: WITH period_returns AS (SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, LAG(close) OVER (PARTITION BY index_symbol ORDER BY trade_date) AS prev_close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY) SELECT index_symbol, ROUND((close - prev_close) / prev_close * 100, 2) AS return_pct FROM period_returns WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM period_returns);

sql_templates.description: Identify leading sectors based on stage scores over the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template: SELECT sector, AVG(stage_score) AS avg_stage_score FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_stage_score DESC;
